channel.title: Talawanda High School News
channel.description: News and announcements from Talawanda High School, including events, athletics, clubs, and important dates.

item.title: Oxford Parks Master Plan Survey
item.description:
The City of Oxford is developing a Parks Master Plan with Pros Consulting and seeks feedback from Talawanda families who use the parks. Complete the survey at https://engagepros.mysocialpinpoint.com/oxford, which includes a survey, virtual mapping, and vision board to help shape the future of Oxford's parks. Visit cityofoxford.org or call 513-523-6314 for more information.

View original newsletter

item.title: Older Americans Month Community BINGO Challenge
item.description:
Older Americans Month (May 2026, theme: "Champion Your Health") features a Community BINGO challenge promoting health and well-being. Pick up BINGO cards at Oxford Seniors (922 Tollgate Dr.), Oxford Lane Library (441 S. Locust St.), The Knolls of Oxford, or Scripps Gerontology Center (396 Upham Hall). Complete activities on the card throughout May, then bring your card to the Intergenerational BINGO Party on Sunday, May 31, 3:00-5:00 PM at Oxford Seniors for prizes and snacks.

item.description:
The graduation ceremony is scheduled for May 21, 2026. Students can pre-order an optional AdvancePay credit for free shipping on photo orders of $35+ after the event. Once event images are ready (allow 2-3 business days for processing), students will receive a text notification. To get started, text 50728GY26 to 90738 or visit https://my.photoday.com/g and enter your phone number followed by your access code.

item.title: Graduation Timeline and Important Dates
item.description:
The Graduation Rehearsal is May 21st at 11:00 AM at Talawanda High School. Students must bring their Cap, Gown, and Tassel to rehearsal or they cannot participate in commencement. Commencement begins promptly at 6:30 PM at The Marvin Wilhelm Athletic Complex at Talawanda HS (graduates must arrive by 5:30 PM). After the ceremony, students return gowns when picking up diplomas; all gowns are rentals and must be returned after the ceremony. Diplomas not received on May 21st can be picked up May 27th, 8:00 AM-2:00 PM in the Main Office.

item.title: Class of 2026 Graduation Information
item.description:
Seniors must complete the Scholarship Post Secondary Google Form by April 21st. Information collected will be used in the commencement program. Graduation is May 21st, 2026 at 6:30 PM at Talawanda High School, 5301 University Park Blvd. Oxford, OH 45056. Graduates must arrive no later than 5:30 PM. Graduation practice is May 21st at 11:00 AM in the THS Gym (arrive by 10:15 AM). Students must provide their transportation. Participation in commencement is optional, but if you don't attend rehearsal, you will NOT be permitted to participate in the ceremony. Cap and gown from Jostens are required (rental items must be returned right after the ceremony). Diplomas can be picked up May 27th between 8 AM-2 PM if not attending. Photos will be available at www.events.lifetouch.com and ceremony will be live-streamed on "Brave TV Channel 85" on YouTube.

item.title: Lions Club Eyeglass Collection Drive
item.description:
The Oxford Lions Club is collecting used eyeglasses, sunglasses, and cases to donate to children in need worldwide. The donated glasses are modified to meet individual children's vision needs, with the Lions Club sending over 900 pairs annually. Donations should be sent to Betsy Beaton at Marshall Elementary School or Shaunna Tafelski at the Board Office by mid-May. Pick-up or drop-off available at Marshall Elementary or the Board Office.
